role: ブラウザー用フィルターの公開配布元（release authority）

heads.note: 最新の main head は `git rev-parse origin/main` で確認してください。この値は本ファイル作成時点の記録です。

gates.PUBLICATION_HOLD: active: Release作成・公開範囲変更・購読URL変更は所有者承認まで保留
gates.NO_NEW_INTERNAL_PUSH: active: main への直接 push 禁止（作業ブランチへの push と PR 作成は可）

protection.main_ruleset: PR必須（承認0）・必須チェック test / engine（Filter list checks）・force-push禁止・削除禁止
protection.ci_zip_guard: Filter list checks の test ジョブで追跡中の *.zip / *.7z を検出すると FAIL

downstream.pinned_import: faaff/ai/imports/s.json（取り込み対象ファイルに実差分がある場合のみ faaff 側で別PRを作成して検証）
downstream.sync_rule: Check the exact faaff/ai/imports/s.json excluded_paths. The current excluded paths include AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, ai/HANDOFF.md, and ai/PROJECT_STATE.json; do not generalize to all ai/*.

open_items: git 履歴に RPLAY_*.zip（約4MB×10）が残存。完全削除には filter-repo + force-push + GitHub Support 依頼が必要（要承認・未実施）
LICENSE ファイル未配置（ライセンスは各フィルターのヘッダーで宣言）
has_wiki が有効（未使用と推定・未検証）
Actions に main に存在しないワークフロー「Validate v2 filters」が登録残り

governance.authority: AGENTS.md on current main; re-read exact main/PR HEAD and checks before each change
governance.scope: Autonomous research, method selection, multilingual research, implementation and tests only within authorized permissions
governance.approval_gate: GitHub Ruleset requires 0 code reviews, but repository policy separately requires explicit owner approval for main merges; the 2026-10-31 governance PR merge received direct delegated approval
governance.continuation: News monitoring observes material AI changes; existing development quality audit checks applicability. Neither guarantees automatic memory synchronization or unattended commits.
governance.production_impact: No release, product runtime, public filter path, subscription URL, deployment, or distribution changed by the governance merge
governance.verification_note: PR test/engine successful; post-merge docs-only push is excluded from s workflow push paths
